question: In a mature sourdough starter, which are more numerous: the yeasts or the bacteria?
answer: The bacteria, by far. Lactic acid bacteria typically outnumber the yeasts 10 to 100 to one, at hundreds of millions of cells per gram. The bigger yeasts make most of the gas that lifts the loaf; the bacteria make its acids. A spoonful of starter holds more bacteria than there are people on Earth.
move: The loudest worker in a team is rarely the most numerous one.
source: Minervini et al., Applied and Environmental Microbiology, 2012
